title: RealICU: Do LLM Agents Understand Long-Context ICU Data? A Benchmark Beyond Behavior Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2605.13542v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Intensive care units (ICU) generate long, dense and evolving streams of clinical information, where physicians must repeatedly reassess patient states under time pressure, underscoring a clear need for reliable AI decision support. Existing ICU benchmarks typically treat historical clinician actions as ground truth. However, these actions are made under incomplete information and limited temporal context of the underlying patient state, and may therefore be suboptimal, making it difficult to assess the true reasoning capabilities of AI systems. We introduce RealICU, a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory. We formulate four physician-motivated tasks: assess Patient Status, Acute Problems, Recommended Actions, and Red Flag actions that risk unsafe outcomes. We partition each trajectory

translated_title: RealICU：大语言模型智能体真的理解长上下文ICU数据吗？一个超越行为模仿的基准测试
translated_abstract: 重症监护病房（ICU）产生长而密集且不断演变的临床信息流，医生必须在时间压力下反复重新评估患者状态，这凸显了对可靠AI决策支持的迫切需求。现有的ICU基准通常将历史临床医生的操作作为真值标准。然而，这些操作是在信息不完整且对潜在患者状态的时间背景了解有限的情况下做出的，因此可能是次优的，这使得难以评估AI系统的真实推理能力。我们提出了RealICU，这是一个用于在真实ICU条件下评估大语言模型（LLM）的后视标注基准，其中标签由资深医生在审查完整患者轨迹后创建。我们设计了四个由医生需求驱动的任务：评估患者状态、急性问题、推荐行动，以及可能导致不安全结果的危险信号行动。我们对每条轨迹进行划分……
tldr: RealICU是一个由资深医生回溯完整患者轨迹后进行标注的ICU评估基准，通过患者状态评估、急性问题、推荐行动和危险信号四个医生视角的任务，突破传统“模仿历史医生行为”的评估范式，从而更真实地衡量大语言模型在ICU长上下文数据上的临床推理能力。
